extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Open your encrypted vDocs vault inside Obsidian.
problem: Users need a secure way to store and manage highly private, encrypted documents within their existing Obsidian workflow without compromising security.

relations.evidence: Same format as the vDocs app, so they open in either.
If you use Obsidian Sync, turn on Sync all other types so .vdocs and .vdj files sync too.

summary: vDocs allows users to open and interact with an encrypted vDocs vault directly inside Obsidian, keeping private documents encrypted on disk.
